rv.q: The most terrifying thing about 'The Enfield Haunting' is that nobody stepped in to stop it before it reached the West End.
The entire show is as disappointing as a wet Halloween.
...the show cannot be saved from its incoherent script and poor casting...This suggests a troubled production, that sadly is the true haunting at Theatre.

cn.t: Critics savage this poltergeist thriller as a fright-free disaster, citing an incoherent script and poor execution that fails to generate scares. Reviewers call it "coarse, clumsy," and "a snoozefest," with the production itself deemed more terrifying than the show.
